---
title: "Rat Naal Hanera Akhiyaan Wich Kar Ke Abid Turda Aaway Lyrics In Punjabi 2018"
language: "Panjabi"
lang: "pa"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Zeeshan"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Rat Naal Hanera Akhiyaan Wich Kar Ke Abid Turda Aaway.
Kuj Ainj De Moor Ne Galiyaan De Jay Wekh Laway Te Marjaway.
Zainab De Be-Parda Sir Ne Aye Hal Banaya Abid Da.
Jad V Uthda Aye Turan Layi Oss Wailay Ronda Dig Jaway.

2
Sir Nangay Ayataan Zahra De Quran Diyaan Bazaraan Wich.
Dewan Di Bajaye Ghilaf Siraan Te Har Koi Pathar Warsawaye.
Hasrat Nal Ghazi De Sir Nu Ro Ro Ke Wekhdi Aye Zainab.
Bazaraan Wich Aidi Chadar Nu Jis Welay Zalim Lehraway.

3
Sajjad Diyaan Zanjeraan Sakina De Gal Wich Ainj Paiyaan Ne.
Aidi Bhain De Saa Ruk Jawan Jay Bemar Muhari Sir Chaway.
Lakhaan Di Khalqat Tun Mangda Bemar Kafan Masooma Da.
Har Ik Zeeshan Qadam Da Rah Aiday Seene Te Phat Paway.

رَت نال ہنیرا اکھیاں وچ کر کے عابد تُردا آوے
کجھ اینج دے موڑ نیں گلیاں دے جے ویکھ لوے تے مر جاوے
زینب دے بے پردہ سر نے ایہہ حال بنایا عابد دا
جد وی اٹھدا اے تُرن لئی اوس ویلے روندا ڈگ جاوے

۲

حسرت نال غازی دے سر نوں رو رو کے ویکھدی اے زینب

\"\"\"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

p = Path('src/data/lyrics/rat-naal-hanera-akhiyaan-wich-kar-ke-abid-turda-aaway-lyrics-in-punjab-tajpoints-0f37f9eb65b4b9923304.md')
before, body = p.read_text().split('\\n---\\n')
header, roman = before.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')
names = {name.lower(): name for name in 'Abid Zainab Zahra Quran Ghazi Sajjad Sakina Zeeshan'.split()}
lines = []
for line in roman.splitlines():
    words = re.sub(r\"[A-Za-z]+\", lambda m: names.get(m[0].lower(), m[0].lower()), line.strip())
    lines.append('  ' + words[:1].upper() + words[1:] if words else '')
for edition, numerals in [(body, '۱۲۳'), ('\\n'.join(lines), '123')]:
    stanzas = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(stanzas) == 3
    for stanza, numeral in zip(stanzas, numerals):
        number, *verses = stanza.splitlines()
        assert number.strip() == numeral and len(verses) == 4
p.write_text(header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join(lines) + '\\n---\\n' + body)
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi across three matching stanzas. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, updated the titles and script metadata, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Rat” as رَت (blood) and rendered the ambiguous “Muhari” phonetically as مہاری.
